## Conclusion

Mead way resin have the highest flexural strength in non- thermocycling conditions compared to Meliodent, and Vertex resins, and even after the thermal cycles, it have the highest  flexural  strength  compared  to  the  four  types  of acrylic  resin.  The  flexural  strengths  of  all  resins  were significantly reduced after thermocycling.
